name: Economic Warfare
summary: A Magram centaur asks you to bring gold and silver to Desolace. The clans value carved wood, while the Magram see use in your kind’s currency.

sections.title: A Different Bargain
sections.body: The Magram Clan’s speaker tells you that the centaur clans trade carved wood bearing tales of their glory and conquests. Only the most level-headed among them may bargain with other clans, and such trade offers a reprieve from battle. The Magram ask you to bring gold and silver, though those metals hold no value for them.

faq.q: What does the Magram Clan want?
faq.answer: The Magram Clan asks you to bring gold and silver.

faq.q: What do the centaur clans trade?
faq.answer: The centaur clans barter with intricately carved wood that tells of a centaur’s glory and conquests.

faq.q: Why do the centaur trade carved wood?
faq.answer: Carved wood is the centaur clans’ barter, and the carvings share tales of a centaur’s glory and conquests.

faq.q: Who may trade with other centaur clans?
faq.answer: Only the most level-headed centaur are permitted to engage with other clans.

faq.q: What does trade mean to the centaur?
faq.answer: Trade is the only reprieve from battle for the centaur clans.

faq.q: Are gold and silver valuable to the Magram?
faq.answer: No. The Magram regard gold and silver as worthless, just as your kind regards their totems.
